provider_http_401.advice: Check the saved API key, credential scope and provider endpoint; do not retry unchanged credentials.

provider_http_403.advice: Check model/account permissions and provider access restrictions.

provider_http_404.summary: Provider endpoint or model was not found
provider_http_404.advice: Check the API base path and exact model name against provider documentation.

provider_http_429.summary: Provider rate or quota limit reached
provider_http_429.advice: Check quota and rate limits; reduce concurrency or wait for the provider limit to reset.

provider_http_408.advice: Inspect provider latency and the configured timeout before retrying.

provider_http_5xx.summary: Provider service returned a server error
provider_http_5xx.advice: Check provider service status and configured fallback models; retry only under the existing policy.

provider_timeout.advice: Inspect the recorded timeout and provider latency; use a suitable timeout or another configured model.

provider_request_failed.advice: Inspect the system code and cause chain; check DNS, connectivity and TLS configuration.

invalid_provider_json.summary: Provider response is not valid JSON
invalid_provider_json.advice: Check API protocol compatibility and whether a gateway returned HTML or truncated data.

invalid_provider_response.summary: Provider response does not match the expected schema
invalid_provider_response.advice: Check the selected API protocol and provider response shape; inspect schema diagnostics without copying private payloads.

invalid_provider_content_type.summary: Provider returned an unexpected content type
invalid_provider_content_type.advice: Check the API endpoint and gateway configuration; the model route expects a JSON response.

invalid_tool_arguments.advice: Inspect the tool name and schema-validation details; correct the planning/tool contract rather than retrying the same arguments.

schema_validation_failed.advice: Inspect the safe validation codes and expected types at the recorded operation.

database_busy.advice: Check concurrent writers and transaction duration; do not replay uncertain writes automatically.

database_readonly.advice: Check the mounted database directory and process write permissions.

database_full.advice: Check available disk space and storage limits before writing again.

database_corrupt.advice: Stop uncertain writes, preserve a backup and inspect database integrity before recovery.

database_constraint.advice: Inspect the operation and constraint code; correct conflicting or invalid data before retrying.

tool_execution_failed.advice: Inspect the tool name, operation and underlying cause; no successful tool result should be assumed.

image_read_unsupported.advice: Check adapter image-reading support and the configured vision route.

media_fetch_failed.advice: Inspect the transport cause and media-source validity; expired URLs may require platform refresh.

image_download_url_unavailable.summary: Platform did not return an image download location
image_download_url_unavailable.advice: Check platform get_image support and whether the image reference has expired.

invalid_or_unsupported_image.summary: Image bytes could not be safely decoded
invalid_or_unsupported_image.advice: Check image format, byte size and pixel limits; a MIME label alone does not prove an image is valid.

media_size_limit.advice: Use a smaller image within the documented byte and pixel limits.

route_not_configured.summary: No model route configured for this purpose
route_not_configured.advice: Configure a compatible model for the recorded purpose in Models; a vision task requires vision capability.

credential_not_configured.advice: Save the provider API key in the Models page or the adapter key in its plugin page.

all_models_failed.advice: Inspect the root cause and attempted model details; changing the outer turn label cannot resolve the provider failure.

no_compatible_model.advice: Check the route model list, enabled providers and required text, tool or vision capabilities.

unknown_error.advice: Inspect the sanitized technical description, error type and stack; report the trace ID with these diagnostics.

cause_not_captured.advice: This boundary did not retain the original failure; inspect adjacent trace events and report the missing capture point.

ECONNREFUSED.advice: Check that the configured service is listening and reachable from this runtime.

ENOTFOUND.summary: DNS name could not be resolved
ENOTFOUND.advice: Check endpoint spelling and DNS availability from this runtime.

ETIMEDOUT.advice: Check network reachability, service latency and configured timeouts.

EACCES.summary: Operation lacks filesystem or network permission
EACCES.advice: Check the process identity and permissions for the failing operation; do not disable security controls blindly.

ECONNRESET.advice: Check upstream connection stability and gateway limits before retrying.

TypeError.summary: Runtime value has an unexpected type
TypeError.advice: Inspect the safe technical detail and first application stack frame for the invalid operation.

model_timeout.advice: Inspect the recorded timeout and provider latency; use a suitable timeout or another configured model.

database_locked.advice: Check concurrent writers and transaction duration; do not replay uncertain writes automatically.

SQLITE_LOCKED.advice: Check concurrent writers and transaction duration; do not replay uncertain writes automatically.

SQLITE_CONSTRAINT.advice: Inspect the operation and constraint code; correct conflicting or invalid data before retrying.

EAI_AGAIN.summary: DNS name could not be resolved
EAI_AGAIN.advice: Check endpoint spelling and DNS availability from this runtime.

UND_ERR_CONNECT_TIMEOUT.advice: Check network reachability, service latency and configured timeouts.

EPERM.summary: Operation lacks filesystem or network permission
EPERM.advice: Check the process identity and permissions for the failing operation; do not disable security controls blindly.

invalid_image_data.summary: Image bytes could not be safely decoded
invalid_image_data.advice: Check image format, byte size and pixel limits; a MIME label alone does not prove an image is valid.

unsupported_image_format.advice: Check image format, byte size and pixel limits; a MIME label alone does not prove an image is valid.

invalid_provider_usage.advice: Check the selected API protocol and provider response shape; inspect schema diagnostics without copying private payloads.

duplicate_tool_call_id.advice: Check the selected API protocol and provider response shape; inspect schema diagnostics without copying private payloads.

unknown_tool_call.advice: Inspect the tool name and schema-validation details; correct the planning/tool contract rather than retrying the same arguments.

unknown_tool.advice: Inspect the tool name and schema-validation details; correct the planning/tool contract rather than retrying the same arguments.

tool_failed.advice: Inspect the tool name, operation and underlying cause; no successful tool result should be assumed.

invalid_media_reference.summary: Platform did not return an image download location
invalid_media_reference.advice: Check platform get_image support and whether the image reference has expired.

http_action_failed.advice: Inspect the HTTP status, adapter endpoint and token permissions.

http_request_failed.advice: Inspect the system code and adapter connectivity; do not assume the message was sent.

invalid_http_response.summary: Adapter returned an invalid HTTP response
invalid_http_response.advice: Check adapter protocol compatibility and response content type.

platform_action_failed.advice: Inspect the platform result code, bot permissions and target availability.

invalid_action_parameters.advice: Inspect the action name and validated parameter contract; do not send malformed parameters again.

missing_send_receipt.summary: Platform did not provide a usable send receipt
missing_send_receipt.advice: The send result is uncertain. Inspect platform history before retrying to avoid duplicate messages.

send_failed.advice: Inspect the adapter or platform root cause and already-confirmed segment count before retrying.

planner_timeout.advice: Inspect the Planner route timeout and task complexity; reduce research scope or configure an appropriate budget. This is not a user cancellation.

dialogue_timeout.summary: Dialogue composition exceeded its stage budget
dialogue_timeout.advice: Inspect the dialogue route timeout, model latency and response size; choose an appropriate budget. This is not a user cancellation.

TLS_ERROR.advice: Check the endpoint hostname, certificate validity and trusted certificate chain; do not disable TLS verification.

CERT_HAS_EXPIRED.advice: Check the endpoint hostname, certificate validity and trusted certificate chain; do not disable TLS verification.

DEPTH_ZERO_SELF_SIGNED_CERT.advice: Check the endpoint hostname, certificate validity and trusted certificate chain; do not disable TLS verification.

ERR_TLS_CERT_ALTNAME_INVALID.advice: Check the endpoint hostname, certificate validity and trusted certificate chain; do not disable TLS verification.

UNABLE_TO_VERIFY_LEAF_SIGNATURE.advice: Check the endpoint hostname, certificate validity and trusted certificate chain; do not disable TLS verification.

SELF_SIGNED_CERT_IN_CHAIN.advice: Check the endpoint hostname, certificate validity and trusted certificate chain; do not disable TLS verification.

planner_invalid_plan.summary: Planner returned an invalid response plan
planner_invalid_plan.advice: Inspect the safe plan-validation details and planning model/tool compatibility. Require one valid structured plan before dialogue composition.

planner_missing_plan.summary: Planner did not return a response plan
planner_missing_plan.advice: Inspect the safe plan-validation details and planning model/tool compatibility. Require one valid structured plan before dialogue composition.

planner_ambiguous_plan.advice: Inspect the safe plan-validation details and planning model/tool compatibility. Require one valid structured plan before dialogue composition.

planner_missing_decision.advice: Inspect the safe plan-validation details and planning model/tool compatibility. Require one valid structured plan before dialogue composition.

planner_forbidden_tool.summary: Planner requested a tool outside its authority
planner_forbidden_tool.advice: Keep research and planning in Planner; delivery belongs to the validated dialogue path. Inspect the allowed tool contract rather than granting broader privileges.

planner_forbidden_action.summary: Planner requested an action outside its authority
planner_forbidden_action.advice: Keep research and planning in Planner; delivery belongs to the validated dialogue path. Inspect the allowed tool contract rather than granting broader privileges.

planner_invalid_delivery_tool.summary: Planner attempted to use an invalid delivery tool
planner_invalid_delivery_tool.advice: Keep research and planning in Planner; delivery belongs to the validated dialogue path. Inspect the allowed tool contract rather than granting broader privileges.

dialogue_forbidden_tool.summary: Dialogue model requested a planning-only or unauthorized tool
dialogue_forbidden_tool.advice: Dialogue should compose and send only from the grounded plan. Move search, meme selection and complex tool use back to Planner.

planner_unknown_asset.summary: Plan referenced an unknown meme or asset
planner_unknown_asset.advice: Use asset IDs returned by the current authorized asset search; do not invent or reuse unverified IDs.

planner_invalid_target.summary: Plan contained an invalid reply target
planner_invalid_target.advice: Select a live target and topic from the current scene and turn; recalled or cross-scene targets must not be used.

planner_unknown_target.summary: Plan referenced a target not present in the current turn
planner_unknown_target.advice: Select a live target and topic from the current scene and turn; recalled or cross-scene targets must not be used.

planner_invalid_topic.summary: Plan referenced an invalid conversation topic
planner_invalid_topic.advice: Select a live target and topic from the current scene and turn; recalled or cross-scene targets must not be used.

planner_unknown_evidence.summary: Plan referenced evidence that was not retrieved
planner_unknown_evidence.advice: Use bounded, deduplicated references to evidence actually returned in this planning turn; do not fabricate grounding.

planner_duplicate_evidence.advice: Use bounded, deduplicated references to evidence actually returned in this planning turn; do not fabricate grounding.

planner_evidence_too_large.summary: Plan evidence exceeded the allowed size
planner_evidence_too_large.advice: Use bounded, deduplicated references to evidence actually returned in this planning turn; do not fabricate grounding.

planner_round_budget_exhausted.summary: Planner exhausted its reasoning round budget
planner_round_budget_exhausted.advice: Reduce planning scope or configure a suitable bounded budget; stop rather than silently running extra rounds or tools.

planner_tool_budget_exhausted.advice: Reduce planning scope or configure a suitable bounded budget; stop rather than silently running extra rounds or tools.

planner_duplicate_action.advice: Inspect the prior action result and operation ID; do not repeat an action with possible external effects.

planner_stale_action.summary: Planner action became stale before execution
planner_stale_action.advice: Revalidate scene, source and cancellation state before starting a new plan; never execute stale actions.

planner_invalid_no_reply.summary: Planner combined a no-reply decision with reply actions
planner_invalid_no_reply.advice: Inspect the safe plan-validation details and planning model/tool compatibility. Require one valid structured plan before dialogue composition.

planner_context_ineligible.summary: Planning context is no longer eligible
planner_context_ineligible.advice: Revalidate scene, source and cancellation state before starting a new plan; never execute stale actions.

planner_tool_failed.advice: Inspect the recorded tool/action and underlying cause; preserve any confirmed effects and avoid unsafe replay.

planner_action_failed.advice: Inspect the recorded tool/action and underlying cause; preserve any confirmed effects and avoid unsafe replay.

planner_failed.advice: Inspect the captured root cause, model, budget and attempted operations; the outer stage failure alone is not a diagnosis.

dialogue_failed.advice: Inspect the captured root cause, model, budget and attempted operations; the outer stage failure alone is not a diagnosis.

image_processing_failed.advice: Inspect the retained download, decoding or vision-model cause; do not assume the image was understood.

turn_tool_failures.summary: The turn contains unresolved tool failures
turn_tool_failures.advice: Inspect the specific tool and cause. Confirmed sends are not undone; do not blindly resend.

database_statement_failed.advice: Inspect source frames, schema and migration versions; do not log SQL or user content.

database_io_error.advice: Check disk, filesystem and process permissions; establish commit state before retrying.

database_open_failed.advice: Check that the database directory exists and the process can access it.

database_permission_denied.advice: Check process identity, file permissions and database authorization.

database_schema_changed.advice: Check migration versions and concurrent schema changes before preparing statements again.

invalid_provider_request_policy.summary: Invalid provider retry or timeout setting
invalid_provider_request_policy.advice: Use 0–5 extra retries and 100–300000 milliseconds per attempt in provider settings.

protocol_configuration_error.advice: Check the protocol plugin and its provider configuration; unchanged configuration is not retried.

model_stage_timeout.advice: Increase the role stage budget if all configured attempts should fit; provider timeout applies separately to each attempt. No further retry was started.

invalid_role_budget.advice: Check the configured total role budget.

memory_proof_budget_exhausted.summary: Memory evidence traversal reached its safety limit
memory_proof_budget_exhausted.advice: Narrow the requested history or inspect the dependency graph. No evidence was declared invalid or deleted because of this limit.

planner_evidence_budget_exhausted.advice: Narrow the retrieved evidence or adjust the explicit byte limit. No token count or missing fact is inferred.

budget_restore_accounting_hold.summary: Model and embedding requests are paused after recovery, even when experimental budgeting is off.
budget_restore_accounting_hold.advice: Displayed amounts cover retained records only; later spending may be missing. This is not reconciled accounting. Midnight and restart do not clear the pause. Management and non-model reads remain available.

planner_unknown_state_evidence.summary: Plan referenced evidence that was not retrieved
planner_unknown_state_evidence.advice: Use bounded, deduplicated references to evidence actually returned in this planning turn; do not fabricate grounding.

planner_target_outside_admitted_topic.summary: Reply target was not admitted to this topic
planner_target_outside_admitted_topic.advice: Reading history is not permission to consume another active or deferred topic. The stale plan is stopped; no automatic send retry is created.

planner_unknown_memory_evidence.summary: Plan memory selection does not match a retrieved receipt
planner_unknown_memory_evidence.advice: Use the outer tool receipt ID as evidenceId and inner record IDs from that same receipt as memoryIds. Keep selections unique and within the limit; do not guess missing references.

planner_incomplete_relation_evidence.summary: Plan relation selection omits required evidence
planner_incomplete_relation_evidence.advice: Select the complete returned relation group, including required records and counterclaims, or omit the group. Do not discard qualifications to make the selection fit.
